description: This file defines the Menu class for the typeahead.js library, including its constructor, methods, and event handling logic.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: A class managing the suggestion menu in typeahead.js, handling rendering, user interaction, and dataset management.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds event handlers for user interactions and dataset events.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the menu is currently open.

methods.name: setLanguageDirection
methods.description: Sets the text direction (e.g., 'ltr' or 'rtl') for the menu.

methods.name: selectableRelativeToCursor
methods.description: Returns a selectable element relative to the current cursor position.

methods.name: setCursor
methods.description: Sets the cursor to a specific selectable element.

methods.name: getSelectableData
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with a selectable element.

methods.name: getActiveSelectable
methods.description: Returns the currently active (highlighted) selectable element.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the menu with a new query and datasets.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Clears all datasets and resets the menu.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the menu and unbinds all event handlers.
